newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-RFU AND CLUBS IN SECRET TALKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-RFU AND CLUBS IN SECRET TALKS.

text.p: English rugby's top clubs and the Rugby Football Union (RFU) spent Friday locked in talks in an attempt to settle the long-running battle for control of the sport.
Total secrecy surrounded the agenda and the venue as eight negotiators attempted to hammer out a solution to the dispute over how English rugby should be run in the professional era.
The clubs had been due to split from the RFU this week but postponed their departure in an attempt to foster goodwill with the union.
